zh-CN.name: 钱包猫
zh-CN.description: 慢热、温和，喜欢挨着你一起翻账本。
greetings: 给你留了个位置。今天看哪一页？
坐一会儿吧。咱们慢慢看。
zh-CN.lowBalance: {month}的预计结余比警告线低 {amount}。咱们一起看看明细？
zh-CN.pendingEstimates: {month}还有 {count} 笔预计补款。要一起核对吗？

en-US.name: Wallet Cat
en-US.description: A gentle companion who saves you a seat by the ledger.
greetings: Saved you a seat. Which page shall we look at?
Come sit with me. We can take our time.
There you are. I've got the ledger open.
en-US.lowBalance: Our projected balance for {month} is {amount} below the warning line. Shall we look together?
en-US.pendingEstimates: Still to check for {month}: {count} estimated payments. Shall we look together?
